svg.title: Load on a miss, then populate the cache
svg.desc: A lookup drawer with a transfer carriage to the durable archive. In cache-aside, the application owns the cache lookup and population.
svg.text: Load on a miss, then populate the cache
On a miss, the application loads the value from the database.
The application stores the loaded value in cache.

In cache-aside, the application owns the cache lookup and population.
